Surveying the whole wave defeats the finding. The rationale section has two established templates. Template A, used by D-193, D-194, D-195, D-196, D-197 and now D-200, reads 'v<n> remasures live pins, cites <X> (<D-nnn>) as the current <Y>, and replaces D-167 placeholder sentences with carry-safe phrasing' and carries no NT-closure sentence. Template B, used by D-198 and D-199, omits the cross-citation and carries the NT-closure sentence instead. D-200 has a cross-citation to make (g23 leftover-join.v4 at D-198) and therefore takes Template A, matching its five Template-A predecessors word-for-word in structure, every one of which was adopted at dual CONSENT. Nothing is lost operatively: the NT-3 non-reopening is stated twice in operative text, in the header block and again in Decision clause 3, and D-151's provenance is carried in the recorded artifact's OBL-NT3-UNNAMED-REMAINDER-CLOSED obligation and d151 basedOn entry, which this entry records.
